description: Try an offer against one of your own products and see the answer a buyer would get (accept, counter or reject), with the limits behind it. Nothing is recorded and nobody is bound, and it works while offers are off, so you can check your terms first. Needs a Last Price credential with price compute scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

offered_price.description: The price the pretend buyer offers.

previous_counter.description: The counter you made in the round before, if any.

product_id.description: Your own id for the product, as buyers name it in an offer.

round.description: Which round of the negotiation this is. Defaults to 1.

name: preview_offer
